pages.title: 1. Change a buy price
pages.text: Goal: make an apple worth 20 per stack.$(br2)$(bold)Steps$()$(br)1. Create $(thing)data/<your namespace>/economic_product/apples.json$().$(br)2. Content: $(thing){"entries": [{"item": "minecraft:apple", "price": 20}]}$().$(br)3. Run $(thing)/reload$() and check the news page.$(br2)Data pack entries take priority over $(thing)products.entries$() in config.

pages.title: 2. Add a system shop
pages.text: Goal: open a shop that only sells building blocks.$(br2)$(bold)Steps$()$(br)1. Create $(thing)data/<your namespace>/shop/builders.json$().$(br)2. Write $(thing)title$() and $(thing)entries$(), each with item or tag, count and price.$(br)3. Run $(thing)/reload$(), then open a Shopping Computer.$(br2)For a few items you can also use $(thing)shop.extra_entries$() in config; they merge into one "config shop".

pages.title: 3. Edit the delivery menu
pages.text: Goal: keep rotten flesh and spider eyes off the menu.$(br2)$(bold)Steps$()$(br)1. Open $(thing)flavor_immersed_daily_argo-economy.toml$().$(br)2. Add ids to $(thing)takeout.food_blacklist$(), one per line:$(br)$(thing)minecraft:rotten_flesh$()$(br)$(thing)minecraft:spider_eye$()$(br)3. Restart.$(br2)The blacklist only affects the delivery menu, not what players can eat.

pages.title: 4. Exchange and shop limits
pages.text: $(li)Exchange: edit $(thing)exchange.entries$(), or use $(thing)/fidaeco add$() and $(thing)/fidaeco delete$(); changes save instantly.$(br)$(li)Disable player shops: $(thing)shop.player_shops_enabled = false$().$(br)$(li)Limit shops per player: $(thing)max_shops_per_player$(), range 0~64; 0 forbids them entirely.$(br2)Remember: price changes affect how existing worlds feel, so run them on a test server first.
